variables.name: bucket_name
variables.description: The name of the S3 data bucket. Must be globally unique across AWS.

variables.name: owner
variables.description: Team or individual responsible for this bucket (DSV required tag: owner).

variables.name: cost_center
variables.description: Cost center code for billing (DSV required tag: cost-center).

variables.name: region
variables.description: AWS region where the bucket will be created. Must be a DSV-approved region.

outputs.name: data_bucket_id
outputs.description: The name (ID) of the S3 data bucket.

outputs.name: data_bucket_arn
outputs.description: The ARN of the S3 data bucket.

outputs.name: data_bucket_region
outputs.description: The AWS region the data bucket was created in.

outputs.name: log_bucket_id
outputs.description: The name (ID) of the access-log bucket.

outputs.name: log_bucket_arn
outputs.description: The ARN of the access-log bucket.
